description: Add background images to VS Code. Use one for the entire window or set them by area, with presets, image rotation, and live updates.
config.enabled: Show background images. When you first enable backgrounds, confirm the patch, then quit and reopen VS Code.
config.mode.fullscreen: Show one image across the entire window.
config.mode.parts: Set separate backgrounds for the editor, side bars, and panel.
config.sources: Add images from files, folders, or HTTP and HTTPS URLs. UshiroE stores local copies in the image folder (`#ushiroe.libraryFolder#`). Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, SVG, and WebP.
config.source.id: Unique ID used to select this source as a background.
config.source.name: Display name.
config.source.type: Source type: file, folder, or URL.
config.source.path: Original file or folder path, or URL to download from. Changing it imports the source again.
config.source.recursive: Include images from subfolders when importing a folder.
config.fullscreen: Background for the whole window, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `fullscreen`.
config.editor: Background for the editor area, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.sidebar: Background for the primary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.auxiliaryBar: Background for the secondary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.panel: Background for the panel, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.area.enabled: Show a background in this area.
config.area.source: Select a source ID, `*` for all images, `preset:<id>` for a preset, or `null` for no image.
config.area.opacity: Image opacity, from 0 (invisible) to 0.8. Higher values would hide the UI behind the image.
config.area.size: How the image fits inside the area.
config.area.position: CSS `background-position` value, such as `center` or `right bottom`.
config.patch.hideCorruptWarning: Update VS Code's checksum for the verified workbench file to suppress the corrupt installation warning. Removing the patch restores the original checksum.
config.patch.autoRepair: Reapply the patch automatically if a VS Code update removes it.
config.source.refresh: When to download a new copy of an image from its URL.
config.source.refresh.never: Download when the source is added. Use Download Again to refresh the copy.
config.source.refresh.startup: Download a fresh copy at each VS Code startup.
config.presets: Ordered lists of images. Create them in the UshiroE view and select one under Image for the area you want.
config.libraryFolder: Folder where UshiroE stores images, with one subfolder per source. You can also add image files directly to those subfolders. Leave empty to use `UshiroE` in your Pictures folder. Changing the folder imports the sources again and leaves the previous folder intact.
config.backImage.priority: Choose which extension manages the background when BackImage is active. Both extensions modify the same VS Code files.
config.backImage.priority.ushiroe: Let UshiroE manage the background. If BackImage is active, UshiroE waits for you to uninstall or disable it before modifying VS Code.
config.backImage.priority.backImage: Let BackImage manage the background while it is active. UshiroE leaves VS Code's files unchanged and skips automatic repairs.
config.allImages: Rotation settings for All images (`*`). Images follow the source order, then the image order within each source.
config.preset.images: Image references in display order, each in the form `<source ID>/<filename>`.
config.rotation.random: Choose the next image at random.
config.rotation.interval: Time between image changes, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timed rotation.
config.rotation.changeOnStartupOnly: Switch images only when VS Code starts. At startup, show the next image in order or choose one at random.
